hooks.name: No cd in shell commands
hooks.description:
Intercepts shell tool usage to ensure agents use the cwd parameter instead of cd or && chains, which trigger unnecessary approval prompts

Migration note: Tool categories were converted to the tool-name matcher `^(execute_bash|execute_pwsh|control_bash_process|control_pwsh_process|list_processes|get_process_output)$`, reconstructed from the built-in tool list. Confirm it covers the tools you meant, then enable the hook.

action.prompt: Check if the command about to be executed contains "cd " at the start or uses "&&", "||", or ";" to chain commands. If it does, STOP and rewrite the command to use the cwd parameter instead. The workspace root is /Users/abodis/Projects/My-Time-Web. For example, instead of "cd /Users/abodis/Projects/My-Time-Web/infra && cdk synth", use command="cdk synth" with cwd="/Users/abodis/Projects/My-Time-Web/infra".
